content.comment_body: Hello, I am attempting to display the remaining time for an active User Defined Function (UDF) block but am unable to retrieve the value via VM (Variable Memory) mapping. When I expand the UDF block, it reveals an on-delay timer that does show the remaining time. Is it possible to utilize this on-delay timer for VM mapping to access the value? I am looking to obtain the value labeled B044, as shown in my attached file.
Please check the attached example and screen recording.
That's the solution I needed. Thank you very much!

analysis.insight_summary: The user struggled to use VM mapping to access the remaining time value from a timer within a User Defined Function block in the software. Advice from another user, along with an illustrative example, quickly helped resolve the issue. This suggests the main challenge was workflow clarity or findability within the software interface, not a technical limitation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to conveniently access and map internal timer values—such as 'remaining time'—from within UDF blocks via VM mapping, allowing these outputs to be used elsewhere in the application.
